newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Quorum Health Group started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Quorum Health Group started.

text.p: -- Rauscher Pierce Refsnes Inc said Wednesday it initiated coverage of Quorum Health Group Inc with a buy-market outperformer rating and a 12-month price target of $38.
-- The company's fundamentals are improving, with same-store admission growth of seven percent compared with an industry average of less than one percent, Rauscher said.
-- Quorum should benefit from a consolidation trend in the hospital industry in future years, Rauscher said.
-- Quorum is a leading hospital management company, with ownership of 18 hospitals and management contracts with nearly 250 additional facilities.
-- Its shares were off 1/2 Wednesday afternoon at 31-3/8.
